title: Data model for a granular 3D printing process reading
description: CIRCULOOS data model for a sensor reading taken on the cartesian granular 3D printer, covering slurry and adjuvant flow, extrusion head temperatures, motor intensity and speed, and circuit pressure during a print run.

value.description: Exact measured value, when a single figure is known.

minValue.description: Lower bound of the value, when the source declares a range or a minimum.

maxValue.description: Upper bound of the value, when the source declares a range or a maximum.

unitCode.description: Unit of measurement of the value, given as a UN/CEFACT code where one exists.

id.description: Property. Unique entity identifier, with the format urn:ngsi-ld:3DPrintingProcess:cartesian-printer:<printRun>:<readingId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be 3DPrintingProcess

temperatureInput.description: Property. Expected unitCode: CEL. Temperature of the slurry in the injection.

temperatureOutput.description: Property. Expected unitCode: CEL. Temperature of the slurry in the output of the extrusion head.

additiveFlowRateSetPoint.description: Property. Expected unitCode: P1. Theoretical percentage of adjuvant injected in the extrusion head.

additiveFlowRate.description: Property. Expected unitCode: LTR/HUR. Flow of adjuvant in the circuit.

slurryFlowRate.description: Property. Expected unitCode: LTR/HUR. Flow of slurry in the circuit.

motorIntensity.description: Property. Expected unitCode: AMP. Electrical intensity of the motor of the extrusion head.

rotationSpeed.description: Property. Expected unitCode: RPM. Speed of the motor of the extrusion head.

pressure.description: Property. Expected unitCode: BAR. Pressure of the slurry in the circuit.

printingTime.description: Property. Expected unitCode: MIN. Time to print a defined part.
